svg.text: INSTRUCTIONAL MOCKUP — NOT A LIVE CAPTURE OR RESULT
Create your working folder and practice page
Application server (TLS-APP01) · RHEL 9 Bash terminal · learner@10.90.0.10
RHEL 9 — learner@tls-app01
COMMAND / FILE CONTENT TO ENTER — PRESERVE CASE
mkdir -p ~/tls-work
cd ~/tls-work
pwd
sudo install -d -m 0755 /usr/share/nginx/html/tls-lab

printf '%s\n' '

TLS practice application

Hosted on TLS-APP01.

' | sudo tee
/usr/share/nginx/html/tls-lab/index.html > /dev/null
sudo restorecon -Rv /usr/share/nginx/html/tls-lab
sudo systemctl enable --now nginx
sudo systemctl is-active nginx
EXPECTED RESULT / SIMULATED CLUE — CHECK YOUR OWN MACHINE
pwd shows /home/learner/tls-work; the final line says active.
FOLLOW THE NUMBERED INSTRUCTIONS IN THE LESSON
1. In normal Windows PowerShell, run ssh learner@10.90.0.10 and check hostname.
2. Paste the block below into this Linux session. The page is a stand-in application, not a production
ticketing system.
3. Keep ~/tls-work for public requests and certificate files only. The tilde means your learner home
folder.
No real private key, real certificate result, production access or DoD endorsement is shown.
